gen-gf-comic-neue-outfit: Comic Neue writes like a friendly hand with a pen, every stroke a thin rope of uniform line. Outfit follows in a plain sans whose curves stop short of closing, which keeps the page easy going.
gen-gf-comic-neue-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans has a modern, precise build, with curve endings held well apart and one constant line. And Comic Neue above it adds a casual, handwritten warmth, so the page feels friendly without losing its tidiness.
gen-gf-comic-neue-sora: Sora is geometric and precise, its c and s kept widely parted with no swell at the corners. Sora works best at a modest size beneath the loose, handwritten Comic Neue, which carries the personality.
gen-gf-comic-neue-space-grotesk: Comic Neue brings a friendly pen-and-paper hand, thin as rope and open in its c forms. But Space Grotesk, a geometric sans, would feel stiff if the heading shrank or the body grew large.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-epunda-slab: Bold and commanding, Comic Relief draws its letters without any stroke variation. Epunda Slab, a text serif, does the quieter work, with a gaping c and tall rounded lowercase that stay dignified.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-fauna-one: Comic Relief has a bold, wire-cut look, with strokes that never vary and bowls left open on one side. Fauna One then settles in as a literary serif, its tall middle band and generous e giving the page a bookish counterweight.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-glegoo: Comic Relief hits hard with display strokes that never swell, each bowl left unfinished on one side, so headings land with force. Glegoo, a refined serif, reads with big open counters.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-hanuman: Hanuman is a traditional, refined serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s. Its best quality is the sharp contrast with Comic Relief, whose bold, ruler-straight lines sit at a moderate height.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-kadwa: Kadwa reads as a classic, editorial text serif, with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height throughout. Comic Relief carries the bold heading, so give the body room.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text reads as a literary, dignified serif, with a big entrance into each curve and lowercase bodies filling most of the height. Comic Relief, with no stroke contrast at all, supplies the bold counterpoint.
